14904.overview: Bowser has taken over the Mushroom Kingdom, -He's captured Princess Toadstool and is holding her in one of the seven hotels in the kingdom. Only you and Mario can free the Princess but you'll have to battle Koopas, Parabombs, Banzai Bill, Spiney, Monty, Pat the Bat and other nefarious nasties!

22988.overview: Match colors at Huckleberry Hound's Gift Emporium. Catch balloons at The Flintstone's Balloon Ballyhoo. Rescue Scooby from a haunted maze in Scooby-Doo's Adventure Isle. Snatch silly sounds at Yogi Bear's Pic-a-nic Place. Capture stray satellites in The Jetson's Space Race. Test your knowledge in Top Cat's Top Facts. Win and enjoy a classic cartoon clip in full-motion digital video.

23021.overview: Jan Pienkowski Haunted House is an adaptation of the pop-up children's book of the same name by Jan Pienkowski. In this game for children of ages 4 to 8 they explore a haunted house that's filled with strange creatures and fun-filled games. There is no real horror to be found, but strange ghosts and monsters from both Earth and beyond do hide out in the house. Each room features original art from the pop-up book and can be explored at will. Clicking on hotspots in the room activates funny animations that will appeal to children. These are accompanied by sometimes ominous music but mostly funny sound effects. Using a map of the house the player can quickly travel to any part of the house. There's no real objectives rather than to have fun and explore.

23160.overview: Hieroglyph is a puzzle game with an Egyptian theme. Like in the board game Master Labyrinth the player has control over the layout of a maze that's made out of different tiles. The player has to help the puppet inside to escape. The game offers three difficulties: slow, normal and fast.

194261.overview:
Thumbelina is an interactive telling of the story by Hans Christian Andersen. It features video fragments and stills from the cartoon film by Don Bluth. As the story is told images are show in the background. Many of these images include activities. These activities include coloring, starting animations through clicking on hot-spots and simple puzzles like counting objects and moving shapes to the correct sockets with the cursor.

Colored images start to animate once they are filled in. The whole story is divided into seven chapters, so that it is possible to skip to the activities you want to play, or continue the story at a different time.

418106.overview: The blend of fantasy and reality in Rudyard Kipling’s Just So Stories makes for most enjoyable storytelling. This story of a gluttonous Rhinoceros who got his comeuppance is told by Jack Nicholson, which music by Bobby McFerrin. In addition to endearing storytelling, this interactive experience offers a detailed parents guide which will help you enrich your child’s learning experience. You can choose an age level for games, display the story text on screen so kids see the words as they hear them, and select activities related to the story.

This popular tale of the camel who said “Humph” once too often is recounted by Jack Nicholson, with music by Bobby McFerrin.
